title: Main.java — demoState() (State)
text:
=================================================
  Pattern 5: State
=================================================
Same hero, behavior changes with HP; transitions happen automatically.

[Recruit] Flash the Speedster joins the squad! (Aggressive style)
Start: Available (power 100%)
  >> Flash is now OnMission
Enter battle -> OnMission
Taking a big hit (down to low HP)...
  >> Flash is now Injured
  Now: Injured (power 60%)  HP 15
Taking a finishing blow...
  >> Flash is now Retired
  Now: Retired canAct=false
